request.style: English, male baritone rock voice, electric guitar, acoustic guitar, bass, drums, organ, uplifting and reverent mood, 95 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri
From the tribe of Judah he stands before me
I have filled him with the Spirit of God
With skill and understanding to build His house

[Chorus]
Designing works in gold and silver and bronze
Cutting stones and carving wood with grace
In every kind of craft the wisdom flows
To make the sanctuary as I command

[Verse]
I have appointed Oholiab to work with him
From the tribe of Dan they share the call
I have given skill to every craftsman
So they can make what I have commanded

[Chorus]
Designing works in gold and silver and bronze
Cutting stones and carving wood with grace
In every kind of craft the wisdom flows
To make the sanctuary as I command

[Verse]
The tent of meeting and the ark of testimony
The atonement cover on top of it all
The table and the lampstand and the altar
Woven garments for Aaron to serve as priest

[Chorus]
Designing works in gold and silver and bronze
Cutting stones and carving wood with grace
In every kind of craft the wisdom flows
To make the sanctuary as I command

[Bridge]
Moses told the people what the Lord had said
Bezalel was filled with skill and knowledge
He made the ark of acacia wood
Overlaid with pure gold inside and out

[Outro]
Mercy seat of gold with cherubim
Wings spread upward overshadowing the place
Facing each other in the holy spot
Just as the Lord had commanded them to make
